title: Digga le sumaq
intro: Adda xer aydaadi fakkiimeh, ummattak aggiriqqe sinni fidga baxxaaqissam mango qanxaffe foocal. ken aydaadi ayfaf sumaqtah imaan, walaa ellecabo fida lih garayta wak. Ta akkaawonti caddok dagah yan zulmi saduh tan imaan cayla nee kassissa.
clues: Nanu buttak sugneeh, aydaadu uxxuk, caylale suurat, qawwalaylak takkaawisah.
Nanu inki rabbi, Arshi Rabbi, Faatitle numul linoh nan imaan baysam faxah yan miraacak foocal sugne.
Nanu ardi addat cotteh tan kaxxa boodo edde anuk bohoyle aqayyaareh addat sugne.
nanu nubleh yaamineenit, alaaqa edde anuk, too boodoh addat qanxixxeh tan infernoh addat qideenih.
Nek gadaamah yan mari ken abtootah abaarot sugeeh, nanu ninni diggah kaxxa acwa xagnineh sugne wak.
Amoyti ni imaan bargusuh abeh yan gibbati dubuk Yallih foocal shahiid akkuk ni arac maqarrosseh, kulliimih sumaq kinni.
arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
